classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: food-processor topping and salad prep (1); continuous rolling/topping while batches bake (2); flatbread + salad (1); rolling thin dough and transferring to a hot pan (1); food processor, parchment, hot pan, batch timing (2). Sum 7 = involved (floor: continuous attention + other ≥1 also satisfied). Complexity: 14 countable ingredients (salt, pepper, oil excluded) -> 1; Aleppo pepper and sumac are spice-aisle items at major chains -> 1; topping paste + sumac salad builds -> 1; sourcing scored once -> 0. Sum 3 = standard. Store-bought dough keeps it weeknight-real without lowering effort below involved. Matches WAVE proposal.
